1.

entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Supplementary affidavit filed today.
The same is taken on record.

2. Heard learned counsel for the applicant and learned A.G.A. for the State and perused the record.
3.

The instant bail application has been filed on behalf of the applicant with a prayer to release him on bail in Case Crime No. 700 of 2022, under Sections 420, 406, 467, 468, 471, 120-B I.P.C., Police Station- Shahpur, District- Gorakhpur, during pendency of the trial.
4. Learned counsel for the applicant submitted that applicant is innocent and has falsely been implicated in the present case due to ulterior motive.
No specific role has been assigned to the applicant.
There is no evidence against the applicant to connect him in the present case.

Further Khurseed Ansari vs State Of U.P. And Another on 22 May, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/155938872/
1

entities.text: Khurseed Ansari vs State Of U.P. And Another
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
submission is that co-accused Jamil Khan and Dinesh Paswan have been granted bail by Co-ordinate Bench of this Court vide order dated 16.05.2023 and 15.05.2023 passed in Crl. Misc.
Bail Application No. 20025 of 2023 and 20544 of 2023 and the case of the applicant stands on identical footing, hence he is entitled to be enlarged on bail on the ground of parity.

entities.text:
Crl. Misc.
Bail Application No. 20025 of 2023 and 20544 of 2023
entities.label: CASE_NUMBER

sentences.text: The applicant has no criminal history but after arrest he has falsely been implicated in five cases on the same day.
Moreover, there is no prospect of trial of the present case being concluded in near future.
The applicant is languishing in jail since 10.02.2023 and in case he is enlarged on bail he will not misuse the liberty of bail and co-operate in trial.
5. Learned A.G.A. has opposed the bail prayer of the applicant.

6. Considering the entire facts and circumstances of the case, submissions of learned counsel for the parties and keeping in view the nature of offence, evidence, complicity of accused and without expressing any opinion on the merits of the case and the law laid down by the Apex Court in Satendra Kumar Antil Vs. C.B.I. & Another, passed in S.L.P.(Crl.) No. 5191 of 2021, the Court is of the view that the applicant has made out a case for bail.

entities.text: Satendra Kumar Antil Vs. C.B.I. & Another
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: The bail application is allowed.

7. Let the applicant, Khurseed Ansari, who is involved in the aforesaid case crime, be released on bail on his furnishing a personal bond and two sureties each in the like amount to the satisfaction of the court concerned subject to following conditions.
Further, before issuing the release order, the sureties be verified.
i. The applicant shall not tamper with the prosecution evidence by intimidating/ pressurizing the witnesses, during the investigation or trial.
ii. The applicant shall cooperate in the trial sincerely without seeking any adjournment.
iii. The applicant shall not indulge in any criminal activity or commission of any crime after being released on bail.
8. In case of breach of any of the above conditions, it shall be a ground for cancellation of bail.

Order Date :- 22.5.2023 Anjali  Khurseed Ansari vs State Of U.P. And Another on 22 May, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/155938872/
